scope: one-seed internal COD train/validation baseline analysis
selection: equal-source macro S_alpha; all accompanying metrics from the same selected epoch
E_phi_semantics: mean of threshold curve (not adaptive E)
evidence_limits: Only comparison.json files are available locally; checkpoint bytes and predictions cannot be independently verified.
One training seed, no per-image predictions; no significance interval or multi-seed stability claim.
R0/R1 and R2/R3 share initialization hashes within architecture; different detail architectures do not share an entire identical initialization.
These 3232/808 development results cannot be compared directly to published official-test SOTA scores.
AMP skips cause tiny differences in successful updates; planned epoch and batch budgets are identical.
